title: Not speaking readings
symptom: On all versions after 2018.11.15, a Motorola G4 set up as a follower will not speak any readings after the first one when starting speak readings.
cause: A commit between 15th Nov and 25th Nov caused the issue; the developer identified one thing it could be and reverted it.
fix: The developer reverted the problematic commit in the 3rd Dec nightly, and the user confirmed it works correctly on that version.
evidence_quote: I have looked through all the commits between 15th Nov and 25th Nov and there is only one thing I think it could be. I will revert that for the next nightly.
